p08_original_target: For supplied concrete H1 paths define ENNReal budgets, prove improper-endpoint equivalence, zero-window formulas, J6<=J<=6J6, gauge/Fourier finiteness equivalences and sublevels.
p08_original_completion_criterion: Take the minimum with the finite cutoff before toReal. No finite budget is assumed to define the budget. Canonical datum instantiation waits for P11/P18.

packages.review: The minimum is taken in ENNReal before toReal. The literal open observation domain, zero windows, countable cofinal and full left-filter improper limits include infinite budgets. One common finite bound on all partial budgets is required; individual partial finiteness is not substituted.

Budgets use actual native physical H1 enstrophy and the six original projections. Positivity of viscosity is explicit in finiteness/sublevel equivalences. Normalizations Y=4*pi^2*F, J=16*pi^4*B and L^4=4*nu*J=64*pi^4*nu*B are preserved. Finite-gauge membership is defined independently of global lifetime; no canonical solution family is constructed.

The carrier is the literal thirteen-component real Hilbert graph with every original compact smooth test at both derivative levels. Actual Hessians and diagonal Laplacian yield full ordered-pair norm identity. Higher derivatives are constructed fields on this graph; no PDE evolution or sharp Sobolev estimate is claimed.

The frequency symbol is the actual orthogonal projection onto the complement of the frequency span, with explicit formula including zero. MemLp construction and Hermitian symmetry give a real L2 operator. The all-L2 range is the original compact-test Solenoidal predicate, including the reverse implication without an H1 premise.

Only elementary scalar-symbol data are inputs: measurability, evenness and a finite bound. Actual L2 multiplication, real transport, and weak-gradient commutation are proved. Real range or derivative identities are not input fields.

The native symbol is exp(-4*pi^2*nu*t*norm(xi)^2). The actual L2 and H1 operators, zero time, semigroup, contractions and strong continuity are constructed. No solution-existence, positive-time H2, forced evolution, or nonlinear PDE premise is inserted.
